when: Hero, CTA, simple announcement, single statement. Centered headline + sub + 1-2 buttons stacked vertically. Lots of breathing room.
Hero with imagery, contact + form, about + portrait, side-by-side comparison. Two columns, equal or 60/40, stacks on mobile.
Immersive hero, dramatic CTA, restaurant/fitness/event hero. Full-width image or video placeholder with dark gradient overlay, text positioned bottom-left or center.
Product grid, team grid, services grid, feature cards, blog index, classes. 2-4 columns of similar cards.
Galleries, mixed-height testimonials, magazine-style image showcases. Uses CSS columns with break-inside-avoid.
Menu courses, schedule, FAQ, work index, changelog, pricing breakdown. Vertical stack of rows with hairline dividers between.
Feature showcase, capabilities overview. One large showcase cell + 3-5 supporting cells of varied sizes in a grid.
Process, company history, project stages. Left rail with dots, milestones to the right.
Process, how-it-works, onboarding. Horizontal or vertical 3-5 steps with large numerals.
Capabilities, skills, categories, filter chips. Flex-wrap of pill-shaped tags.
Testimonial spotlight, mission statement, manifesto. Large centered pull-quote with author below.
Booking, contact, reservation, signup. Two columns where one side is copy and the other is a form card.
Press, partners, customers, certifications. Horizontal row of wordmarks at reduced opacity.
Editorial portfolio showcases, work indices. Mixed-aspect cells with staggered offsets, dense typography.
Metrics, results, proof points. 3-5 horizontal blocks each with a big number and small label.
Top navigation. Brand left, links center or right, optional CTA right. Adapts to vertical (cart for ecommerce, reservations for restaurant, etc).
Site footer. Brand + tagline column + multiple link columns + bottom legal row.
Locations, contact with address. Two columns: location details and map placeholder.
Multi-category menu, schedule by day, product categories. Horizontal tab bar at top with content beneath the active tab.
Long-form feature explanations, story scrolls. Stacked blocks where image side alternates left/right per block.
